title: latest-or-bust.json
description: latest-or-bust's config: the dependencies held back on purpose, and the pull requests between branches that aren't checked.

exempt.description: Package name to why it's held back.

allow.description: "minor": it may stay on its current major, but must be the newest release there. Left out: it isn't checked at all.

promotions.description: Pull requests that promote one branch into another, which aren't checked on GitHub Actions: their dependencies were checked on the way into the first branch. Defaults to develop into main or master; [] checks every pull request.
